annotations.title: Generate an image from a text prompt

description: Text-to-image generation with FLUX.1 schnell. Send a prompt, get a 1024x1024 JPEG back as base64 in a few seconds. Use for illustrations, thumbnails, mockups, avatars and social media images. Optional steps parameter (1-8, default 4) trades speed for detail. Example: prompt=a lighthouse on a cliff at sunset, watercolor, steps=4. Price $0.02/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits); failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
